files.user-profile-james.md:
---
name: user-profile-james
description: James's background, hobbies, pets and programming skills
type: user
---
James loves video games (currently playing The Witcher 3, loves story and atmosphere). Tried programming in college; knows Python and C++; has built a website and game mods. Has two dogs, Max and Daisy; they know tricks (sit, stay, paw, rollover) and he trained them himself; he sees them as family. Loves bowling (got 2 strikes on 16 March 2022). Writes his goals in a notebook and checks them off; stays motivated by setting small goals and tracking progress. Once had his wallet stolen while absorbed in slot machines. Has tried VR gaming and loves it. As of 20 March 2022 he made a game avatar and joined a new online gaming platform/community, enjoying chatting and sharing tips with other gamers; he is also trying different styles of games. As of 27 March 2022: started learning an instrument a few days earlier (practicing daily, said instrument unnamed in chat; John plays drums), got a new cutting-edge gaming system with great graphics, and is exploring RPGs and strategy games. Gaming is his refuge and "like therapy" when overwhelmed; also relaxes with games after work.

As of 4 April 2022: joined an online gaming tournament on 3 April 2022 and reached the semifinals (lost there). Met the whole team of pro players, got autographs and tips (key lesson: communicate well, never put ego above team success). Uses voice chat with teammates. Favorite game to play with his team is Apex Legends. Interested in trying RPGs and MOBAs next; promised to update John.

As of 12 April 2022: adopted a third dog, a pup named Ned, from a shelter in Stamford about 5 April 2022; says he has made his days happier. Prefers waiting for bugs to be fixed before trying games, but agreed to try John's recommended new futuristic dystopia RPG (John to send a link).

As of 20 April 2022: on 14 April 2022 he built a Witcher 3-inspired virtual world with a gaming friend (programming + gaming project); he made a game character modeled on a woman he saw on a dog walk about 6 April 2022 (fell for her at first sight, didn't approach her). Travel: loves traveling; has visited Italy (last year), Turkey and Mexico. Wants to take a trip abroad with John next year and said he'd start looking for a destination.

As of 23 April 2022: took his dogs hiking on Thursday 21 April 2022 (nice trails, great views); enjoys nature to clear his head. Supportive friend who offers advice when John is stressed.

As of 29 April 2022: bought a fantasy adventure book (with novels and art) about 26 April 2022; loves the fantasy genre; will check out "The Name of the Wind". Has played the turn-based strategy game Civilization VI for about a month (enjoys planning/resource management). His dogs like to watch him game and cuddle (Daisy lay next to him). Has heard of the impostor-style party game and wants to try it with a large group.

As of 4 May 2022: Daisy is a Labrador who loves toys and food; the other two dogs are shepherds (very loyal). Says pets, computer games, travel and pizza bring him happiness. Favorite pizza: pepperoni; also likes cheese and prosciutto. On Friday 29 April 2022 a bug broke the game mechanics in his weeks-long game project; after failing to fix it alone, a group of friends helped him fix it.

As of 23 May 2022: went to an amusement park with friends the weekend of 14-15 May 2022 (roller coasters, Ferris wheel, electric cars, buggies). Finished a big months-long project in April 2022 (had to learn a new language; learned problem-solving, patience, perseverance) and feels more confident for bigger projects.

As of 13 June 2022: recently started a course combining gaming and programming; currently working on a football simulator, where he built the player databases. Big football fan and devoted Liverpool supporter (watches every match, hopes they win the title next season); has a friendly bet with John (Man City fan) that Liverpool finish higher.

As of 16 June 2022: said a lot has happened lately, some good and some bad; has at least two people who reliably support him. Max (one of his shepherds) is a pro swimmer (beach/lake), catches frisbees mid-air, and cheers him up. Walks Max on a quiet trail a mile from home, bringing a book to relax; says nature helps him think straight. Plans to check out John's recommended books (Stormlight Archive, Kingkiller Chronicle, The Expanse).

As of 19 June 2022: started introducing Max, Daisy and Ned to each other on Friday 17 June 2022; hard at first but they're adapting and bonding. Volunteered in May 2022 with an organization providing necessary items/gifts to people in need; found it rewarding. Offered to take John there this weekend (no interview needed) and introduce him to staff.

As of 9 July 2022: won an online gaming tournament about 2 July 2022. Newly into extreme sports: rope jumping from 150 m (~8 July) and surfing (~6 July); says surfing relaxes him. Also likes reading to relax. Bought tickets to Toronto, leaving evening of 11 July 2022, also plans Vancouver, returning 20 July 2022; will bring John a souvenir.

As of 22 July 2022: trip done; also visited Nuuk (Greenland), a new country for his bucket list; brought souvenirs for John and John's Jill. Has played chess before. Childhood friend of John; skateboarded at age 10 (sometimes left class early), still rides sometimes and taught his dogs to balance on a skateboard (they chase it and run with it). Has a sister who visited with the dogs about 21 July 2022; they watched an ocean sunset together. Was tired after the last two days.

As of 6 August 2022: took his puppy (Ned) to the vet clinic on 5 August 2022 for a routine checkup and seasonal canine disease vaccination. Says his pets are his source of joy.

As of 10 August 2022: took his three dogs to a beach outing on 9 August 2022 to bond with other dog owners; met a woman named Samantha, who gave him her phone number; planned to call her on 11 August 2022 to ask her out on a date. Also plays The Witcher 3.

As of 21 August 2022: not in any online groups, but has a regular gaming group that streams sessions and recently had a get-together; hosted an all-night gaming marathon with friends. Setup: gaming PC, keyboard, mouse, comfy chair.

As of 26 August 2022: plays on a console too; Ned came to him while gaming. Now wants to create a strategy game like Civilization someday (likes their depth). Planned to meet John at McGee's Pub on 27 August 2022 (suggested Starbucks first).

As of 1 September 2022: finished his Unity strategy game (inspired by Civilization and Total War; challenges were balancing mechanics and fairness; lessons: perseverance, patience, feedback and collaboration). Proud of it and shared a screenshot with John.

As of 4 September 2022: on 3 September 2022 at the theater he asked Samantha to be his girlfriend and she said yes. She loves theater and lager beer (they went to McGee's bar). Invited John to a baseball game with them on Sunday 11 September 2022 (John agreed). Signed up for a cooking class about 2 September 2022 ($10/class; made omelette, meringue, dough); never liked cooking before, wants to cook for John later.

As of 18 September 2022: has been busy and now writes everything he needs to do in a notebook. Gets ideas from books, movies and dreams; a few weeks earlier he had a vivid dream of a medieval castle with a labyrinth of puzzles and traps and made sketches/notes. Likes rock music; played guitar when younger but not lately. Just started streaming games (details pending; hopes it works out).

As of 20 September 2022: streamed a game on 19 September 2022 and got many kind comments from the gaming community, which motivated him to continue. Likes 2D puzzle adventures like Zelda and offered to test John's mobile game. Reads a game dev magazine (tutorials, developer interviews) to improve his game dev skills. Trying to balance work and other activities.

As of 3 October 2022: got a new video card about late September 2022 and is excited to play RPGs on it; considering Cyberpunk 2077 (John recommended it).

As of 13 October 2022: released his first game to the gaming community; found it very fulfilling to see players enjoy it. Witcher 3's world and story inspired it. Plans to make more games in different genres and test new ideas.

As of 21 October 2022: apartment lost power ~18 October 2022 mid-game and he lost progress by not saving (now saves more often). Mother visited ~19 October 2022 with her retired army friend. His first gaming system was a Nintendo; he played Super Mario and Zelda for hours as a kid, which sparked his passion. Started playing Cyberpunk 2077 on 20 October 2022 and finds it addictive. Wants to branch out in programming; John to send resources/tutorials.

As of 31 October 2022: he and girlfriend Samantha decided to move in together and rented an apartment near McGee's bar (the bar was a deciding factor; they love going there).

As of 5 November 2022: started a family road trip on 4 November 2022 with his dogs. Wants to try the sports genre; plans to practice FIFA 23 (John's recommendation, to play together later) and wants chess opening resources from John.

As of 7 November 2022: on the road trip he visited friends Josh and Mark, and stopped at an animal sanctuary with rescue dogs; tempted to take them all home but thinks more than three dogs is too much. Says dogs bring joy and brighten dark days.
files.project-james-game-and-dog-app.md:
---
name: project-james-game-and-dog-app
description: James's personal computer game project and the dog walking app idea with John
type: project
---
Game: James is turning a childhood comic character (he sketched the main character as a kid) into a computer game, combining gaming and storytelling. He plans to keep John updated and may invite John (knows HTML/CSS) to help.

App idea (discussed 17 March 2022): mobile app for dog walking and pet care connecting owners with reliable walkers, with pet care info. Differentiator: personalization, owners add their pup's preferences/needs. Possible joint project with John.
files.user-john-friend.md:
---
name: user-john-friend
description: John, the person James chats with; shared interests and plans
type: user
---
John is a video game fan who plays to relax and escape stress. He just signed up for a programming class (as of 17 March 2022), has some HTML/CSS experience. Doesn't like bowling (fingers too big). Has tried VR a few times. Hasn't played The Witcher 3 yet but plans to. Considering morning runs. New hobby (as of 20 March 2022): metal detecting on beaches with a metal detector; so far mostly bottle caps, a few coins, and once a gold ring. Wants a pet someday but isn't ready yet; James offered to help him find one. As of 27 March 2022: plays drums (about a month, has a drum set), advanced to the next level in a game the previous week, and attended a gaming convention where he played in a CS:GO tournament (CS:GO is his favorite game).

As of 12 April 2022: busy with work, little gaming progress; currently playing a new RPG set in a futuristic dystopia (great story, graphics, tough gameplay, but laggy/buggy); planned to send James a link.

As of 20 April 2022: met three new friends with the same interests in his programming course (on 12 April 2022). Visited a canyon about 18 April 2022 for calm nature time. Motivated by rest, friends and travel. Last country visited: Japan (loved the tech-heavy megacities and street food). Dreams of visiting Italy. Agreed to a possible trip with James next year.

As of 23 April 2022: very busy at work with deadlines; stuck on a difficult coding assignment (making a new algorithm work better). James advised breaking it into smaller steps, researching similar algorithms and asking other programmers; John said he'd keep going. Wishes he could spend more time in nature.

As of 29 April 2022: doing freelance programming; first professional project outside class is a website for a local small business. Progress slow with hiccups; was struggling with adding payments to the site, getting closer to a solution. Likes fantasy books and recommended "The Name of the Wind" to James. Currently playing AC Valhalla; enjoys strategy games and board games with friends (played one ~27 April 2022), and an impostor-style social deduction game.

As of 4 May 2022: had a day off, hosted new friends for a movie watch; trying to socialize more and balance work and fun; invited James to join next time. Favorite pizza: Hawaiian; hasn't tried prosciutto yet (plans to).

As of 8 May 2022: on 7 May 2022 he and friends organized a CS:GO charity tournament with a big turnout. Money went to a dog shelter near his street; leftover funds bought groceries and cooked food for the homeless. He wants to organize more such events (combines gaming and helping the community). James said he's proud of him.

As of 11 May 2022: volunteered his programming skills for a charitable foundation (helps kids): built a smartphone app replacing their paper records/manual inventory, tracking inventory, resources and donations and generating reports. It gave him a sense of purpose; he's now considering volunteer roles and possibly a non-profit career, but hasn't yet looked for an organization.

As of 23 May 2022: on Friday 20 May 2022 he entered a local tournament and took second place (won prize money and a trophy).

As of 13 June 2022: got his dream job after many interviews; starts in July 2022. Is a Manchester City fan; has a friendly bet with James on whether City or Liverpool finishes higher in next season's standings.

As of 16 June 2022: started a blog about coding around 9 June 2022 (exciting but scary; shares his coding journey, connects with other coders). Bought many new books, bookcase nearly full. Loves sci-fi and epic fantasy; favorites: The Stormlight Archive, Kingkiller Chronicle, The Expanse (recommended to James). Says he's been on an emotional rollercoaster lately.

As of 19 June 2022: thinking about his career and making a positive impact; looking into volunteering and non-profit work. Accepted James's offer to visit the organization James volunteered with this weekend (~25-26 June 2022).

As of 9 July 2022: feeling determined and passionate but also overwhelmed and stressed; balancing personal and professional life is hard. Relaxes by reading imaginative worlds.

As of 22 July 2022: just started playing chess to improve strategy (mostly online, also joined a chess club). Has a partner/person named Jill and has siblings (close to them). Still has no pets but wants one someday. Childhood friend of James: at age 10 they skateboarded together at a skate park with a group of friends.

As of 6 August 2022: left his IT job after 3 years (to do something that made a difference) and is loving his new job. Now wants a career in the gaming industry: organizing tournaments for computer games (e.g. CS:GO, Fortnite) in their state; has made some connections and plans to gain experience. James offered financial help/advice.

As of 10 August 2022: branching from shooters into strategy and RPG games and thinking of organizing competitions for them too. Now playing The Witcher 3 and hooked (story, characters, choices shaping the world). Showed James his workplace with wall lighting.

As of 21 August 2022: joined an online programming group (tech for good) on Friday 19 August 2022, exchanged contacts, and collaborated on one project; says it's a one-time experience, not a return to programming, and he's still set on hosting eSports competitions. Bought new devices and refurbished his gaming desk (gaming PC with powerful graphics card, headset, gaming chair, keyboard). Siblings live far away; he's organizing a gaming night with them for September 2022.

As of 26 August 2022: helping his younger siblings with programming since they joined a programming course; they're making a simple text-based adventure game together to learn coding. Doesn't like dark beer (prefers light). Had a day off on 27 August 2022 and planned to meet James at McGee's Pub.

As of 1 September 2022: siblings are already making their own basic games and stories; John finds teaching them fulfilling. He said he's going through some difficult times (unspecified); James offered to listen.

As of 4 September 2022: his parents just started learning coding from him (his father wrote his first program). Bought new gaming gear: Sennheiser headphones and a Logitech mouse. Agreed to go to a baseball game with James and Samantha on Sunday 11 September 2022.

As of 18 September 2022: got into board games; tried "Dungeons of the Dragon" the previous week and found it fun. Likes electronic and rock music; played drums when younger but hasn't lately (earlier notes said he'd started drums in March 2022). Has jammed with friends, no recordings.

As of 20 September 2022: started a startup on 19 September 2022 making portable smokers (already welded one from metal). Also made his first mobile game, a 2D adventure with puzzles and exploration, launching in October 2022; kept it secret for months for fear it wouldn't work out. James offered to help test it and John will let him know when testing is ready. Uses a game design book, tutorials and developer forums; reads a game dev magazine. Said the week was chaotic.

As of 3 October 2022: got an email offering a volunteer gig at a game dev non-profit: programming mentor for game developers (teaching coding, assisting with projects). Very excited; sees it as a start to a career combining gaming and helping. Has played Cyberpunk 2077 and loved it (immersive world, story).

As of 13 October 2022: around 6 October 2022 he and his programmer friends organized an online competition (a blast; everyone showed off skills).

As of 21 October 2022: organized a programming seminar around 14 October 2022 (great turnout, learned new programming approaches, hasn't tried them yet). Promised to send James resources/tutorials. Advised James on Cyberpunk 2077: dialogue choices matter and you needn't befriend every character.

As of 31 October 2022: held a charity gaming tournament with friends on 30 October 2022 (Fortnite, Overwatch, Apex Legends) raising money for a children's hospital; shared a photo.

As of 5 November 2022: won the regional chess tournament on Tuesday 1 November 2022 (strategy: analyze/anticipate opponent's moves; recommends studying openings and past games). Sent James a chess openings resource. Currently hooked on FIFA 23 (online football); offered to play with James once James practices.

As of 7 November 2022: over the weekend (5-6 Nov) collaborated with a game developer on an online board game; a demo is about to be released and he'll tell James when it's out (James wants to try it and give feedback). Still has no dog but really wants one. Has a cousin with a dog named Luna.
